Come on! Come one! We ain't get all day, and I ain't got enough traps to handle your mess-up. Thanks for that, by the way. Soooo excited to replace all of them later. Might want to try that radio you got there. We're close enough to the city where it should work.
Cyber City, this is Commander—can anybody read? We're stuck in the mine and need a way out quick.
We copy, Commander. Hold on. Tracking your location now.

We've got your location. There should be a platform nearby that can take you to reach the main city. Problem is that for you to use it would require us to shut down the city's defenses in that region. If we do that, the zombies will find their way in before we can even reactivate them.
Can't we just take the same way that Trapper did to get in here?
Nah, ship's sailed on that one unless you want to backtrack a mile. But hey, here's an idea. Why don't ya throw yourself into those meatbags and save yourself the trouble while you're at it.
They're starting to catch up to use, V! What's the plan here?

We're moving everyone to the other side of the city and creating a containment area for you. We'll need some time. Try to hold on for as long as you can and make sure everyone is on that elevator. I won't be able to active this again later.
Hey! Agh! ... Is — is anyone there!
Ah! Come on! Is that all you got?
I can't believe they've made it. They've gone mental.
No way. Guys! You need to get down here quick! We don't have much time!
Not sure we can! It's like a maze in here. We're going to see if this tunnel leads us out of here but Agh! But someone loaded the place with mines!

We've cleared out that side of the city. Get ready, we're shutting down the defenses and lowering the barricades. Zombies are already heading in our direction. Once you're out of there, you need to hold on until we can get the turrets back online.
We've got our plan. Recruit, helm me move the survivors to the platform! Soldier, cover Minigunner. Sniper. On me! V, we're almost ready, but two of our guys are stuck in the tunnels.
There are hundreds of gates to the city from the mines. Hopefully one of them will be open when the defenses go down. They just need to hurry.
Reloading! Why did the city need all these crystals anyway? Argh!

Haha! Ah — that's good stuff there, ya know? We mined these rocks for the little energy they carry. Think of it as a battery. I don't know much about the details but you can do some pretty nifty things once they're refined.
Oh sure! Let me send you up now so you'll be crushed by a massive *DOOR*. Agh! Hold on, I'm trying to make sure you don't turn into paste.
We've got some bosses ahead! Watch your feet! There's some crawlers!
One icon and dialogue is randomly chosen upon defeat:
•Mission Failed, we'll get em' next time.
•Mistakes are just part of the journey..
